finding: Fenced code is tracked as one flag flipped at any line starting with three backticks or tildes, so a shorter fence or a fence of the other character inside a block closes it and a quoted ## heading after it becomes one of the read's sections.

The delimiter row is checked only for dashes in each cell, never for its number of cells, and a table with no line after its header passes, so a seven-column table with a six-cell delimiter row or none at all is accepted.
